members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: MCPError subclasses (specifically UrlElicitationRequiredError) fail to unpickle correctly because the default Exception.__reduce_ex__ reconstructs via cls(*self.args), and self.args (set by MCPError.__init__ to (code, message, data)) doesn't match subclass constructor signatures — this is tracked as issue #2431. (2 PRs)

members.cluster_pick_reason: #2478 fixes this at the MCPError base class via a new _restore_mcp_error dispatcher that special-cases UrlElicitationRequiredError.from_error while using from_error_data for every other subclass — this covers the exact UrlElicitationRequiredError/#2431 case #2555 targets, plus every other MCPError subclass generically. It also drops the '# pragma: no cover' on MCPError.data, indicating the payload-preservation path now has direct test coverage. #2555's fix is a narrower, single-subclass __reduce__ override on UrlElicitationRequiredError only; if both land, UrlElicitationRequiredError.__reduce__ (instance-level, from #2555) would shadow the base class's __reduce__/_restore_mcp_error dispatch added in #2478, leaving the UrlElicitationRequiredError special-case branch in #2478's _restore_mcp_error dead and unreachable — redundant code paths solving the same case two different ways in the same file.
